description: Create a Personio person (POST /v2/persons). Required: email, first_name, last_name. Optional: preferred_name, gender, language_code, custom_attributes, employments (array as in the Personio API, e.g. [{ employment_start_date, org_units, supervisor }]). Creates an HR record — needs approval.

email.description: E-Mail (Schlüssel für den Abgleich mit anderen Systemen)

language_code.description: de | en | es | fr | nl | it | sv | fi
